notes.text: Flaw is in KDC get_pac_princ_with_realm(); no krb5kdc in image and no Kerberos use by kube-ovn. This statement concerns CVE-2026-107708 in pkg:deb/ubuntu/libgssapi-krb5-2 as a subcomponent of pkg:oci/kube-ovn?repository_url=docker.io%2Fkubeovn%2Fkube-ovn.
